description: 25 evaluation queries across 5 cohorts evaluating realistic multi-version documentation with changed facts, deleted sections, insertions, reordered sections, and hard distractors.

queries.query_text: How does the storage engine persist writes and manage MemTable flushing?
expected_spans: log-structured merge (LSM) tree architecture optimized for high-throughput write workloads
flushing immutable SSTables to non-volatile flash media

queries.query_text: What mechanism accelerates POSIX inode lookups and ensures atomic renames?
expected_spans: Inode lookups are accelerated through a lock-free concurrent hash table cache with LRU eviction
monotonic sequence numbers to guarantee atomic renames

queries.query_text: What physical disk block size and extent allocation policy is used?
expected_spans: uniform 4KB block size grouped into 64MB contiguous allocation extents
buddy allocation bitmaps to prevent internal fragmentation

queries.query_text: When does chunk garbage collection run and what reference count is required for deletion?
expected_spans: generational mark-and-sweep garbage collector
reference counter reaches zero across all active snapshot manifests

queries.query_text: How does the write-ahead log ensure crash recovery within 15 seconds?
expected_spans: synchronous entry to the write-ahead log (WAL) before updating in-memory state
reconstructing consistent memory state within under 15 seconds

queries.query_text: What is the memory provisioned per worker node in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: provisioned with 32GB ECC DDR4 memory per physical node
16GB specifically for the read block cache
prohibited_spans: 64GB specifically for the read block cache

queries.query_text: Which port does the ingress gateway listen on in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: ingress gateway service listens on TCP port 8080
Unencrypted HTTP/1.1 transport is permitted

queries.query_text: What encryption cipher is used for data-at-rest in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: data-at-rest encryption is enforced globally across all persistent media using AES-256-GCM
x86-64 AES-NI instruction sets

queries.query_text: How is inter-node communication handled in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: legacy binary RPC protocol v1
fixed 16-byte header with a 32-bit magic preamble

queries.query_text: What syntax is used for cluster configuration in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: serialized in XML 1.0 syntax conforming to the cluster-spec-v1
legacy-failover-mode

queries.query_text: What is the memory provisioned per worker node in Version 2.0?
expected_spans: provisioned with 128GB ECC DDR5 memory per physical node
64GB specifically for the read block cache
prohibited_spans: 16GB specifically for the read block cache

queries.query_text: Which port does the ingress gateway listen on in Version 2.0?
expected_spans: ingress gateway service listens on TCP port 9443 with mandatory TLS 1.3
Cleartext HTTP/1.1 transport is completely prohibited

queries.query_text: What encryption cipher is used for data-at-rest in Version 2.0?
expected_spans: upgraded to ChaCha20-Poly1305 stream cipher suites
uniform cryptographic performance across heterogeneous ARM64 and x86-64

queries.query_text: How does the eBPF agent collect block I/O latency and network telemetry?
expected_spans: attached to kprobes and tracepoints along the block I/O submission path
records microsecond-level NVMe request queue latencies, socket buffer drops

queries.query_text: What protocol and network transport provides direct block storage attachment in Version 2.0?
expected_spans: NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF) protocol over 100GbE RoCEv2
zero-copy kernel-bypass connections directly to remote storage controller namespaces

queries.query_text: How does dynamic adaptive rate limiting throttle client requests?
expected_spans: dynamic token bucket algorithm informed by real-time storage backpressure
ensuring bursty analytics jobs do not degrade latency-critical transactional workloads

queries.query_text: Where is the cluster-spec-v1 XML configuration file parsed in Version 2.0?
What is the fixed header size of the custom binary RPC protocol in Version 2.0?
What election timeout interval is configured for Raft consensus in Version 3.0?
expected_spans: aggressive base period of 500ms with a heartbeat tick of 100ms
sub-second leader failover
prohibited_spans: base period of 5000ms and a heartbeat tick of 1000ms

queries.query_text: What election timeout interval is configured for Raft consensus in Version 1.0?
expected_spans: base period of 5000ms and a heartbeat tick of 1000ms
strict majority across at least three distinct availability zones
prohibited_spans: base period of 500ms with a heartbeat tick of 100ms

queries.query_text: How are optimizer states partitioned across GPU ranks using ZeRO-3?
expected_spans: ZeRO-3 memory optimization scheme
partitioned across all active accelerator ranks

queries.query_text: How does React concurrent rendering schedule work units across 5-millisecond slices?
expected_spans: concurrent rendering and interruptible fiber reconciliation
5-millisecond execution slices scheduled through browser requestIdleCallback

queries.query_text: What stream pipeline aggregates usage events to trigger Stripe payment webhooks?
expected_spans: Kafka message queues with at-least-once delivery
Apache Flink stream pipelines to produce aggregated hourly billing rollups

queries.query_text: How does AF_XDP bypass the Linux kernel network stack using UMEM ring buffers?
expected_spans: bypasses kernel TCP/IP protocol stacks by transferring Ethernet frames directly into memory-mapped UMEM
AF_XDP zero-copy socket interfaces

queries.query_text: Which post-quantum algorithm is used for Module-Lattice Key Encapsulation (ML-KEM)?
expected_spans: Module-Lattice-based Key Encapsulation Mechanisms (ML-KEM, standardized from Crystals-Kyber)
NIST Level 3 equivalence
